messages:
deploy-bot: starting rollout rl-2026-05-01-07 canary=7% -> scheduled ramp 25% in 12m
nina: running postdeploy smoke suite, seeing synthetic probe that asserts top-k token distribution shifted for /summarize vs baseline, rouge drop ~0.09 :thinking:
kyle: is this a content regression or sampling variance? latency/5xxs look fine
priya: release notes include a sampling-seed change (fixed_seed=false -> true for better determinism). That could change distributions
nina: probes are deterministic comparators; they started flagging diffs immediately after deployment
triage-bot: INC-2026-333 created - postdeploy semantic divergence detected by smoke probe
kyle: suggestion: pause automated ramp and pin /summarize route to previous variant (v4.8.2) while we confirm whether fixed_seed change intended for prod
nina: +1 pause and pin; want to avoid unexpected user-visible output changes
priya: sample pin call:
```
POST /admin/routing/pin
{"route":"/summarize","variant":"v4.8.2"}
```
ops-bot: routing pin applied to /summarize -> v4.8.2 (actor: ops-bot) :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: smoke-probe (post-pin) -> semantic-fuzz=pass p95=120ms p99=190ms status=ok
kyle: pinging model infra: was fixed_seed toggle shipped intentionally? if yes, we need to quantify user impact and include in release notes
priya: model infra confirms change was intended for A/B experiments but not for global rollout; they will prepare a compatibility patch
nina: keeping canary at 7% for a 30m stability window, will gather example diffs for the RFC
triage-bot: INC-2026-333 marked monitoring; stay open until RFC-2026-305 created and examples attached
kyle: retrospective: add synthetic that runs both deterministic and stochastic variants in preflight for model sampling changes
priya: adding changelog note: "pinned /summarize to v4.8.2 after postdeploy semantic probe flagged distribution shift due to sampling-seed change; model infra to follow-up (RFC-2026-305)"
nina: thanks team, will update after stability window and upload diffs to ticket
ops-bot: note: manual resume of ramp at 6161616205 if all green (actor: kyle)
